items.title: SK Hynix Plans Trinity Fab For May 2027 And Advances Up To 50% Of Supplier Costs #Shorts #FrontPage
items.summary: SK Hynix will advance up to 50% of initial development costs to its vendors and compensate suppliers for completed work even if a project misses its targets. Trinity Fab, scheduled to open in May 2027, will have a 3,305 square meter clean room for advanced lithography, etching, deposition and inspection on 12 inch wafers. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #SKHynix #Semiconductors

items.title: Sarvam Token Factory Hits 330 Tokens Per Second On Its 105B Model #Shorts #FrontPage
items.summary: Sarvam reports a 2.86x throughput increase on its own 105B model, with 330 tokens per second for a single user, after writing custom kernels and a three tier caching system. The introductory price is 10 rupees per million input tokens, and the company says its caching engine hits a 95.7% prompt cache rate across more than 450 billion tokens a day. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #Sarvam #LLM

items.title: Teaching Neural Networks to Undergraduate Science Students | Arun Sharma, 2026 Innovator Awards
items.summary: Can chemistry students with no coding experience train neural networks? Wolfram Innovator Award winner Arun Sharma tells Stephen Wolfram how his scientific computing course takes students from their first list to image classifiers built on their own datasets. items.title: Economics and Physics: Agent-Based Wealth Models in Mathematica | Bruce Boghosian, 2026 Innovator
items.summary: What if wealth moved like gas molecules? Bruce Boghosian, president of the American University of Armenia and a Wolfram Innovator Award winner, shows Stephen Wolfram how kinetic theory and Mathematica produce a first-principles theory of wealth distribution. His models match real wealth data better than standard curves and reveal a surprising phase transition toward oligarchy. #WolframInnovatorAwards #mathematica #Econophysics #wealthinequality #AgentBasedModeling 00:00 Introduction 01:03 Kinetic Theory and Agent-Based Modeling 03:48 From Molecules to Wealth Distributions 05:57 Winner-Take-All Games and Redistribution 08:41 A Phase Transition in Wealth 14:15 Solving the Model with Mathematica 17:31 The Fundamental Problem of Economics 20:07 Runaway Electrons and Oligarchs
